product_metadata.title: Zenna Home Hanging Shower Caddy, Over the Shower Head Bathroom Storage, Made for Handheld Shower Hoses, Rust Resistant, No Drilling, Expandable Organizer with 4 Baskets, Razor Holders, Hooks, Chrome
features: VERSATILE STORAGE FOR YOUR SHOWER: Caddy's 4 baskets slide outward for custom storage and to allow tall bottles to fit
MADE TO USE WITH TODAY'S SHOWER HOSES: Expanding basket feature enables handheld shower hoses to be used with caddy
WITH HOOKS AND HOLDERS FOR MORE STORAGE: Includes built in razor holders and hooks for hanging storage
EASY TO INSTALL AND KEEP IN PLACE: Has non-slip collar for secure fit over showerhead, and includes suction cups to hold caddy in place against wall
ATTRACTIVE AND RUST RESISTANT: Chrome finish looks great and resists rust
description: With baskets that slide out to accommodate a shower hose, the Zenna Home Expandable Shower Caddy is a versatile storage solution for your bath area. The shower caddy’s four storage baskets expand outward so a handheld shower hose can fit conveniently in the middle. The expandable feature also allows the caddy to hold taller bottles and other bath essentials. The caddy installs easily over standard showerheads, with no tools needed. Its chrome finish fits in with most shower décor and hardware choices.
